site_title: Hillvue Haven — SDA Residences in Tamworth
meta_description: Brand new Fully Accessible and Improved Liveability SDA residences at 46 Mustang Close, Hillvue NSW. Built by Brookline Property Group, managed by ADAPT Housing.

hero.pill_text: 46 Mustang Close, Hillvue NSW — Now Available
hero.subheadline: Brand new SDA residences in Hillvue — designed with warmth, built for independence, and crafted to feel like home from the very first day.

welcome.headline: Where everyday living feels
welcome.body_1: Hillvue Haven is a brand new specialist disability accommodation development in Hillvue — a friendly, connected suburb just minutes from the heart of Tamworth.
welcome.body_2: Built by Brookline Property Group, with housing managed by ADAPT Housing and support delivered by Challenge Community Services, it's a place designed entirely around you.
welcome.body_3: The house is built to Fully Accessible standards and the villa to Improved Liveability standards — both delivering real comfort, genuine independence, and a home you'll be proud to call your own.

house.name: Two Bedroom Residence
house.description: Built to Fully Accessible standards with spacious open-plan living, a private outdoor entertaining area, and a dedicated On-site Overnight Accommodation suite for your support team.

villa.name: One Bedroom Villa
villa.description: A beautifully finished compact residence built to Improved Liveability standards. Smart, efficient layout with full accessibility throughout and a private outdoor courtyard.

features.title: Brand New Build
features.description: Never lived in — Hillvue Haven is a purpose-built development delivered to modern SDA design standards with quality finishes throughout.

features.title: Fully Accessible
features.description: The house is certified Fully Accessible — high levels of assisted physical access for wheelchair users, wide hallways, step-free throughout, and roll-under benchtops. The villa is built to Improved Liveability standards.

features.title: Fire Sprinkler System
features.description: Fully integrated fire sprinkler protection throughout the entire home — giving residents and support teams complete peace of mind, every day.

features.title: Maximised Outdoor Living
features.description: Generous covered alfresco areas, level lawn, and private outdoor spaces designed to be enjoyed — somewhere to breathe, relax, and truly make your own.

features.title: Assistive Technology Ready
features.description: Pre-wired smart home infrastructure including wall-mounted control panels so assistive technology can grow and adapt with you as your needs evolve.

features.title: Expert Care Partners
features.description: Housing managed by ADAPT Housing (SDA provider) and daily support delivered by Challenge Community Services (SIL provider) — a trusted, experienced team around you.

quote.text: A home isn't just a place — it's a feeling. Hillvue Haven was built to give you both.

outdoor.headline: Space to
outdoor.body_1: Hillvue Haven was designed with outdoor living at its heart. Covered alfresco areas flow naturally from the open-plan living spaces — blurring the line between inside and out.
outdoor.body_2: Every residence has generous private outdoor space, beautifully landscaped and level — a place to entertain, to sit in the sun, or to simply enjoy the fresh air.
